VT|Group I: Vault without salto (Handspring, Yamashita, Round-off) with or without LA turn in 1st and/or 2nd flight phase.
VT|Group II: Handspring fwd with or without 1/1 turn (360°) in 1st flight phase salto fwd or bwd with or without twist in 2nd flight phase.
VT|Group III: Handspring with ¼ - ½ turn (90° - 180°) in 1st flight phase (Tsukahara) – salto bwd with or without twist in 2nd flight phase.
VT|Group IV: Round-off (Yurchenko) with or without ¾ turn (270°) in 1st flight phase – salto bwd with or without twist in 2nd flight phase.
VT|Group V: Round-off with ½ turn (180°) in 1st flight phase – salto fwd or bwd with or without twist in 2nd flight phase.
